name: Lucid Crafter
body:
You can imbue a sense of reality to objects you create in the Dimension of Dreams.

Prerequisite(s): Lucid Dreamer

Benefit(s): Objects you create through use of the Craft skill or Item Creation feats in the Dimension of Dreams are physical objects which can be carried between planes by physically present creatures. Objects created by impossible feats are not affected by this feat.
